column6: REALITY, close on his real terminal desk in the ministry office, seen from slightly above: his black-gloved hands tear the rose-pink bottom copy off a three-part carbon form set (white, yellow, pink sheets, the top sheet headed MINISTRY OF WAITING, FORM 27B/6); a pen, a rubber stamp and the green glow of his terminal beside it; he has no flowers, so he is about to make one. Keep MINISTRY OF WAITING, FORM 27B/6 exactly.

REALITY, close on his real terminal desk: his black-gloved hands hold up a small, neatly folded paper rose made from the rose-pink carbon copy, crisp origami petals; the torn white and yellow copies of the form lie on the desk beside the green terminal; warm desk-lamp light on the pink flower, the only warm colour in the shot.
